svg.title: CyberGuard system architecture
svg.text: Browser → Next.js frontend (Vercel) → Spring Boot API (Render) → PostgreSQL (Supabase)
Same origin, so no CORS for the browser
Thin: request parameters in, DTOs out
UPLOAD_DIR · UUID file names · SHA-256 hash
Free plan: files are lost on restart or deploy
H2 in memory for backend tests
Backend: JUnit + MockMvc on H2 (23 tests)
Frontend: ESLint and TypeScript check (in CI)
End to end: Playwright (67 tests, run locally)
Own ports 8081 / 3100, never the dev servers
frontend: npm ci, lint, typecheck, build
Vercel builds frontend/ · Render builds backend/Dockerfile
Secrets live only in the hosting dashboards
